title: Valdmark is now in 3D! Medieval sandbox, play the demo!
author: 2nd_breakfastt
selftext:
Hey guys quick update on Valdmark! 

Ive been working on turning my 2d world into 3d world and I’m absolutely in love with it. The world feels more alive and the concepts I was visualizing are coming together especially with the production lines like smithing, woodcutting, etc. 

I’ve always loved games like Rimworld and Kenshi and the freedom and choices it gave you to do and what you wanted so I tried implementing that the best I could into this medieval sandbox

I wanted a player to be able to be a simple farmer and build up their land and sell their crop and make a family, or be a merchant traveling from town to town selling wares making a fortune, or a leader of a party hunting down bandits or even committing crimes, or get an army together and try to siege one of the lords castles and when you’re strong enough maybe even the kings, the list goes on and on

I wanted the player to have a viable and fun play through however they decided  

My process:  
With the 2d layout making it an easier conversion, I bounced back and forth concept art ideas with ChatGPT and Opus 5.5. Opus 5.5 then created all the art itself having it auto connected to Blender/Godot

https://ynotved.itch.io/valdmark

Check out the itch page if you want more info or to try it out yourself! If you do I’d love to hear your feedback. Especially any bugs/improvements

comments.author: yaboyyoungairvent
comments.body: looks up my alley. If you put the 3d version demo online instead of requiring to download it, I would play it. Only thing i would say from my short play of the 2d version is that it would benefit with a tutorial or walkthrough. There seems to be a lot of things going on and complexity, it would be good to have something that walks you through things (doesn't have to be mandatory but at least an option).
